description: Convert between JSON rows and CSV. json_to_csv takes columns and rows, up to 5000 flat objects, and stores result.csv; csv_to_json takes data, the CSV text, and stores result.json. delimiter is a comma, a semicolon or a tab. spreadsheet_safe guards cells a spreadsheet would run as formulas. The result is stored for 24 hours and the answer has its storage_id and storage_url. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: json_csv_convert
title: Convert between JSON and CSV
